notes:
Summary: mid-market SaaS (product onboarding/experience) building an in-app copilot to reduce time-to-first-success. Primary success metric = consistent low-latency guidance (350ms 95th target) + strict token cost caps to keep per-user cost predictable. Evaluating Hosted API as first POC path; interested in Dedicated once throughput and strict residency/security gates are cleared.

Key technical priorities:
- Streaming + function/tool calling: must call product APIs (user profile, step-state) synchronously during turns. Reliable streaming is must-have.
- Token budget enforcement: product team wants per-session token caps (hard cap) and per-route token budgeting to avoid runaway cost.
- Latency SLOs: 95th-percentile <= ~350-400ms for 512-token median sessions; worst-case fallback acceptable but must be documented.
- Deterministic behavior for guided flows: low jitter across users, predictable cold-starts.
- Security: SSO (SAML), audit logs retained 1 year, KMS integration for env keys, data residency EU/NA controls for specific customers.

Quotes / call fragments:
- "We need the copilot to feel instantaneous — even small lag kills engagement." — VP Product (Arielle).
- "If we can't cap token spend per session we can't forecast CAC to LTV economics." — Head of Ops.

POC scope (agreed):
- 2-week hosted API POC embedded in web onboarding flow for two product cohorts (~1k monthly active POC users).
- Measure: per-session token burn, 50/95/99 latency pct, success-to-task completion uplift.
- Implement token caps via Redwood Optimize recommendations + request-level metadata for billing buckets.

- How do we enforce hard token caps server-side? (need implementation pattern + webhook/metric).
- Can we guarantee streaming + function call latencies under 95th target in NA region during peak? Need test harness.
- Pricing: want committed Dedicated quote (monthly) if POC shows solid metrics; finance wants break-even calc within 6 months.
